documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Results - Financial Results For The Quarter And Half-Year Ended September 30, 2026

analysis.summary: Shanti Gold International Limited reported its Q2 and H1 FY27 financial performance, highlighting robust growth in revenue, operating profit, and net profit. Management detailed capacity expansion initiatives including the commercial production commencement at the Marol facility in Mumbai and an upcoming facility in Jaipur. The company also expanded its product portfolio with the introduction of the Turkish jewellery collection, Cuban bracelets, and machine-made plain gold jewellery. Shanti Gold International Limited reported its Q1 FY27 financial results, highlighting strong revenue growth driven by volume expansion and the commencement of operations at its new Marol manufacturing facility. Management maintained its full-year guidance of 50% to 60% value growth and 30% to 40% volume growth, alongside an estimated top-line target of INR3,500 crores.

guidance.claim: The management sticks to its guidance of around 50% to 60% value growth and 30% to 40% volume growth for the year.
guidance.quote: And the top line, we stick to our guidance of around 50% to 60% growth this year. So, if I have to go for the volume and the value, volume will remain largely in the 30% to 40% range and the value will remain in the 50% to 60% range as compared to last year.

demand_outlook.claim: India's jewellery market is supported by strong wedding and occasion-led demand, rising disposable incomes, and an increasing preference for organized and branded jewellery.
demand_outlook.quote: India's jewellery market is supported by strong wedding and occasion-led demand, rising disposable incomes, and an increasable preference for organized and branded jewellery.

demand_outlook.claim: The long-term fundamentals for gold remain very strong and management is very bullish on it.
demand_outlook.quote: The long-term fundamentals remain very strong. So we are hopeful that the gold will, maybe there could be a short-term jitters in the near-term, but going forward in the long-term, we expect a good rally in the gold market, and we remain very bullish on that because the fundamentals remain very strong for the gold.

capex_expansion.claim: The upcoming Jaipur facility is expected to add 1,200 kg per annum in capacity.
Operations have successfully commenced at the new manufacturing facility in Marol, Mumbai.
capex_expansion.quote: The past year has been an important phase in our journey, and we remain focused on building a stronger, more scalable, and sustainable business while continuing to create long-term value for all our stakeholders. Coming to the quarter, Q1 FY27 was an important period for the company, particularly from an operational perspective, with the successful commencement of operations at our new manufacturing facility in Marol, Mumbai.

capex_expansion.claim: The upcoming Jaipur facility will strengthen the manufacturing footprint and is scheduled to be operational around mid-November or December.
capex_expansion.quote: So capex is around INR47 crores what we have allotted for Jaipur facility, and it should be operational around November, mid-November or December, because the factory work is still going on.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin for Q2 FY27 was reported at 6.5%.
EBITDA margin for Q2 FY27 stood at 5.7%.
PAT margin for Q2 FY27 was recorded at 4.0%.
EBITDA margin for Q1 FY27 stood at 9.97 percentage.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin for the quarter stood at 9.97 percentage.

margins_costs.claim: Sustainable EBITDA margin going forward is expected to be around 7.5% to 8%.
margins_costs.quote: So roughly 2% to 2.5% was the inventory gain. So if you remove that percent, roughly going forward, looking at the current demand and all, we should be in the range of 7.5% to 8% EBITDA.

orders_capacity.claim: The current capacity utilization for the existing Mumbai facility is 75%.

capital_allocation.claim: The company raised 99.83 crore via a right issue comprising 46,43,471 equity shares during Q2 FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: During Q2 FY27 , the company raised fund via right issue comprising 46,43,471 equity shares of face value Rs. 10 each, at an issue price of Rs. 215 per share, aggregating Rs. 99.83 crore.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has approved a rights issue of 46,43,471 fully paid-up equity shares aggregating up to INR100 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As part of our growth and capital planning, the company has approved a rights issue of 46,43,471 fully paid-up equity shares of face value 10 each, aggregating up to INR100 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Post rights issue, the total number of shares should be around INR7.67 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: The right issue is 46,43,471 and post rights issue it should be around INR7.67 crores.
